meta.rule: This register reconciles existing boards. It does not implement a suggestion, choose a path, or publish an unsourced number. Every row names a source; repository-only records are labelled as such and are never presented as NFL facts.
meta.decision_state: All paths are proposed and awaiting an owner decision. The owner-decision cell is deliberately blank.

source_boards.scope: 20 three-path suggestions in the unified dashboard
15 console suggestions with recommendation and unlocks
12 second-opinion choices with two or three paths each
12 site-improvement suggestions with a decision field
10 ranked options with evidence and first step
10 next-decision questions with defaults if unanswered

questions.question: Can we know whether our line beats the market?
questions.information_held: Pre-kickoff forecasts and an official-results register are stored in the repository; the official Week 10 schedule prints finals.
questions.information_missing: No licensed opening and closing price with a book name and timestamp is held; the official schedule and standings pages print no betting line.
questions.answer: Not answerable today. A residual or ROI figure would require an unsourced price.
questions.how_to_discover: Adopt a price policy (licensed feed, scheduled self-capture, or keep the market column blank), then score forecasts prospectively.
questions.source_note: Official Week 10 schedule read 2026-11-19: fixture list and finals; no price field.
questions.provenance: console/questions.csv Q-01 and Q-02; next-decisions Q-61

questions.question: What may be called the market in a published comparison?
questions.information_held: A price store exists; its metadata records that no official league price source exists.
questions.information_missing: Whether a third-party mirror may be labelled a market line, and the terms under which it may be republished.
questions.answer: Owner and rights decision, not a data question. The repository default is to leave the official market column blank.
questions.how_to_discover: One written label-and-terms decision; no new collection is required.
questions.source_note: Repository record (not an NFL fact): price-store metadata.

questions.question: Is the injury signal a level or a surprise?
questions.information_held: The official report prints practice status and game status per player per game; the repository holds dated reads of the report.
questions.information_missing: A daily Wednesday-to-kickoff chain with fetch timestamps for the same week, joined to a line observed before each change.
questions.answer: A level alone cannot be a surprise feature. The delta needs a dated chain that is not yet complete.
questions.how_to_discover: Keep a hashed, dated capture per day and compute change from the immediately prior capture only.
questions.source_note: Official league injury report read 2026-11-19: practice and game-status columns are printed.

questions.question: What does Questionable mean in play terms?
questions.information_held: The official report prints the designation and practice status; its text supplies no play probability.
questions.information_missing: Multi-season designations joined to official inactive lists and participation, with confidence intervals.
questions.answer: No percentage can be quoted from the official source. Any number here would be invented.
questions.how_to_discover: Collect dated designations and official inactives over several seasons, then measure play rate by designation.
questions.source_note: Official report: no percentage is printed beside any designation.

questions.question: Who actually started, and how much did each player play?
questions.information_held: An official Game Centre links a Game Book; a repository memo records Lineups, Did Not Play and Not Active sections in one sampled PDF.
questions.information_missing: No verified 32-club snap-count field was found in that sample; no participation dataset is held.
questions.answer: Game Book lineups can evidence listed starters where use is authorised. They do not establish depth rank or snap share.
questions.how_to_discover: Resolve the reuse notice, then verify a separate official participation source before modelling playing time.
questions.source_note: Official NFL-hosted Game Book PDF; reuse notice quoted in the repository memo.

questions.question: Which depth source is authoritative for all 32 clubs?
questions.information_held: The repository holds club depth-chart rows for 31 clubs; Houston publishes its chart as an image.
questions.information_missing: An authorised structured source for the remaining club and a club-by-club verification record.
questions.answer: Route (a), club pages, is verified for 31 clubs, not 32. Do not treat the missing club as empty.
questions.how_to_discover: Verify one authorised structured Houston source, then freeze a club-by-club source register.
questions.source_note: Repository record: depth rows and documented Houston gap.

questions.question: Does not listed mean available?
questions.information_held: The official report lists only the players the club reports; a player on reserve may be absent.
questions.information_missing: An official reserve list versioned to the same date as the report.
questions.answer: No. Absence from the injury report is not evidence of availability.
questions.how_to_discover: Capture the official reserve list at the same clock time as each injury read.
questions.source_note: Official report: reserve status is not a column on this page.

questions.question: Which string replaces an out starter?
questions.information_held: Club depth charts in the repository record replacement strings; shared and empty slots are preserved in the source rows.
questions.information_missing: A uniform 32-club register with rank groups intact, plus game-day confirmation of the replacement.
questions.answer: Answerable in part: 31 clubs have chart rows, Houston does not; the unit is a group of slots, not one named starter.
questions.how_to_discover: Add the authorised structured source and keep rank groups (multiple players at rank 1) as groups.
questions.source_note: Repository record: depth rows and documented parse defects.

questions.question: When and where is each fixture, and what is known before kickoff?
questions.information_held: The official schedule prints date, matchup and finals; the Game Centre prints the stadium; a dated league announcement gives the season frame.
questions.information_missing: Official pre-kickoff roof designation and an NWS hourly forecast joined by grid and hour; neither is held.
questions.answer: Fixture context can be built from published schedule facts. Weather and roof features cannot be built from those facts alone.
questions.how_to_discover: Transcribe each Game Centre venue, then source roof/surface and forecast separately with their own timestamps.
questions.source_note: Official announcement dated 2026-05-14: 18-week, 272-game schedule; Week 10 NE at DET at FC Bayern Munich Stadium.

questions.question: Are two legs independent enough to multiply?
questions.information_held: The repository records a measured leg correlation and the arithmetic of the parlay hold.
questions.information_missing: A directly validated joint probability for the exact leg pair, and the operator void/push rules.
questions.answer: A marginal correlation is not a joint validation. Without both gates a combo cannot be ranked.
questions.how_to_discover: Validate the joint probability prospectively and obtain the operator rules; otherwise keep combos behind the gate.
questions.source_note: Repository record: computed correlation output, not an official league number.

questions.question: Does season-long ROI identify a skilled strategy?
questions.information_held: The repository defines proper-score qualification and a prospective escrow and publishes the luck arithmetic.
questions.information_missing: A scored prospective window with a game-cluster lower bound and a multiplicity adjustment.
questions.answer: No. Short-run ROI cannot separate skill from variance and is not used for ranking.
questions.how_to_discover: Use benchmark-relative Brier skill with uncertainty; keep ROI as an escrow measure only.
questions.source_note: Repository record: scoring rule, not an NFL fact.

questions.question: How many bets before a winning record means anything?
questions.information_held: The break-even hit rate at -110 and the sample-size arithmetic are published in the repository.
questions.information_missing: Nothing further; this is arithmetic rather than measurement.
questions.answer: Far more than a single season of sides. A short winning run is not evidence of skill.
questions.how_to_discover: Keep the pre-registered sample floor; no strategy is promoted on a short run.

questions.question: What sends a live strategy back to paper?
questions.information_held: A demotion gate with thresholds and windows is written into the repository.
questions.information_missing: A live bet log; nothing is live, so no trigger has fired.
questions.answer: The gate is defined and armed, not exercised.
questions.how_to_discover: Ratify the thresholds, then wire the live log to them before the first promotion.

questions.question: How many decisions are competing for attention?
questions.information_held: Seven distinct suggestion or question registers exist in the repository, with different ID schemes and counts.
questions.information_missing: Which one the owner treats as canonical; no register currently reconciles them.
questions.answer: There is no single answer today. This section is the reconciliation surface; it makes no path choice on the owner's behalf.
questions.how_to_discover: Compare the boards on the Review log page, then ratify one canonical ID scheme.
questions.source_note: Repository record: one of the seven source boards.

questions.question: What may be published from row-level official data?
questions.information_held: A repository memo records the NFL Game Book's printed reuse restriction and recommends linking only.
questions.information_missing: A terms review or written permission for extracting and republishing player-level rows.
questions.answer: Until that review exists, keep raw player-level rows and PDF bytes off the public site.
questions.how_to_discover: Record the terms decision; keep linking to the official document meanwhile.
questions.source_note: Repository record: quoted official notice and conservative recommendation.

questions.question: Can we trust a published venue label?
questions.information_held: The official Game Centre prints FC BAYERN MUNICH STADIUM / MUNICH; the official Game Book prints Allianz Arena.
questions.information_missing: A rule for which official label is canonical when two league sources differ.
questions.answer: Both strings are official and differ. Do not normalise by assumption; publish both and flag the difference.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner picks a display convention; keep both raw strings in the register.
questions.source_note: Official Game Centre; the differing Game Book string is quoted in the repository memo.

questions.question: Do the published tables still agree with the official pages?
questions.information_held: On 2026-11-19 the standings, Week 10 schedule, Week 10 injury report, schedule announcement and one Game Centre were re-read for this section.
questions.information_missing: A fresh dated read of every published row in every tree, including the full season schedule.
questions.answer: The five pages read here exist and carry the facts cited here. They also expose three source-format irregularities, flagged not corrected.
questions.how_to_discover: Re-run the dated pack verifiers and transcribe the remaining fixtures before calling the whole site current.
questions.source_note: Official Week 10 schedule read 2026-11-19; 14 fixtures with finals.

questions.question: Are the three Lions game-status cells settled?
questions.information_held: On 2026-11-19 the official report prints Out for Kerby Joseph, Cade Mays and D.J. Reed.
questions.information_missing: Whether a dated repository table should be amended or kept as the frozen read it claims to be.
questions.answer: The live official page and the dated repository table disagree. Both are records; only the live read is verified today.
questions.how_to_discover: Decide an amendment policy for dated snapshots; do not overwrite a frozen capture silently.
questions.source_note: Official injury report read 2026-11-19: the three named rows show Out.

suggestions.title: Decide the price-data policy before publishing any residual
suggestions.problem: The fair-line and market-line columns exist, but no book-identified timestamped price is held.
suggestions.path_b: B. Scheduled self-capture after a terms review.
suggestions.path_c: C. Keep the market column blank and score against our own line only.
suggestions.recommended: C until a written policy exists; then A if funded, otherwise B.
suggestions.why: It decides whether CLV, ROI and the market difference are measurable at all.
suggestions.unlocks: every pricing gate, the leaderboard and ROI
suggestions.source_note: Repository record: price-store metadata; no official league price source exists.

suggestions.title: Finish the verified results register before widening backtests
suggestions.problem: The official Week 10 slate is readable; the stored feed covers a subset of the season.
suggestions.path_a: A. Transcribe each official by-week page into dated packs.
suggestions.path_b: B. Use league standings as a coarse proxy.
suggestions.recommended: A. B loses game-level detail; C adds a dependency.
suggestions.why: Outcome joins are the precondition for every scored gate.
suggestions.source_note: Official Week 10 schedule read 2026-11-19: 14 fixtures with finals.

suggestions.title: Verify participation from a permitted official source
suggestions.problem: Depth rank from jersey order is explicitly rejected; playing-time evidence is not yet held.
suggestions.path_a: A. Authorised Game Book extraction with retained hashes.
suggestions.path_c: C. Keep publishing the headcount only.
suggestions.recommended: C until rights are reviewed; then A if authorised, otherwise B.
suggestions.why: It is the difference between a replacement count and a weighted deficiency.
suggestions.source_note: Official Game Book PDF; reuse notice quoted in the repository memo.

suggestions.title: Capture the reserve list beside every injury read
suggestions.problem: A player on reserve may be absent from the weekly report; absence is not availability.
suggestions.path_a: A. Capture the official reserve list at the same clock time.
suggestions.path_b: B. Rely on club news links.
suggestions.path_c: C. Keep the column blank and marked.
suggestions.recommended: A; keep C as the interim display rule.
suggestions.why: It removes a false negative from the availability truth label.
suggestions.unlocks: Q-07 and all designation reliability work
suggestions.source_note: Official report: reserve status is not a column on this page.

suggestions.title: Automate immutable multi-day availability snapshots
suggestions.problem: One dated capture cannot support a surprise feature or a replay.
suggestions.path_a: A. Daily hashed capture of report and club charts.
suggestions.recommended: A. B cannot show Wednesday-to-Sunday changes.
suggestions.why: It makes the injury signal a delta and makes backtests replayable.
suggestions.source_note: Official injury report; practice and game status are printed per player.

suggestions.title: Resolve the missing Houston depth source
suggestions.problem: The Texans chart is an image; 31 of 32 clubs have parseable rows.
suggestions.path_c: C. Keep Houston blank and flagged.
suggestions.recommended: C until A or B is verified for the club.
suggestions.why: It removes the only 32nd-club gap without inventing a row.

suggestions.title: Publish correlations only from official numbers, with n
suggestions.problem: Some published correlations were computed from a third-party mirror.
suggestions.path_a: A. Recompute from official tables only and print n.
suggestions.path_c: C. Withhold until official inputs exist.
suggestions.recommended: A where inputs exist; C otherwise. Never relabel B as official.
suggestions.why: It prevents a mirror number from being read as a league fact.
suggestions.source_note: Official standings page read 2026-11-19; no third-party numbers are used by this section.

suggestions.title: Separate signal from staking in the leaderboard
suggestions.problem: A lucky staking run can hide a bad signal.
suggestions.path_a: A. Rank by benchmark-relative Brier skill with a cluster lower bound.
suggestions.recommended: A. B and C are explicitly rejected by the brief.
suggestions.why: It makes the ranking about calibration rather than luck.

suggestions.title: Keep parlays and prop combos behind a joint-evidence gate
suggestions.problem: Multiplying marginals is invalid under dependence; void and push rules are not held.
suggestions.path_a: A. Validate joint probability and operator rules, then rank.
suggestions.recommended: C until both gates are met.
suggestions.why: It prevents a dependency error from being advertised as edge.
suggestions.source_note: Repository record: computed output, not an official league number.

suggestions.title: Complete the venue register from Game Centre pages
suggestions.problem: Only one week of fixtures has a transcribed stadium; the schedule page prints no venue.
suggestions.path_a: A. One official Game Centre read per fixture.
suggestions.path_b: B. Infer venue from club pages.
suggestions.recommended: A. B is inference and is not allowed.
suggestions.why: It supplies a published fact for every fixture rather than a guess.
suggestions.source_note: Official Game Centre prints MUNICH / FC BAYERN MUNICH STADIUM.

suggestions.title: Publish the dated schedule announcement beside the live schedule
suggestions.problem: The season frame (272 games, 18 weeks) is published by the league but not shown beside the by-week page.
suggestions.path_a: A. Link the dated release and quote its date.
suggestions.recommended: A. It is an official, dated, linkable fact.
suggestions.why: It fixes the fixture count and the season frame in one line.

suggestions.title: Ratify one canonical suggestion register
suggestions.problem: Seven boards with different IDs and counts compete for the owner attention.
suggestions.path_a: A. Adopt this reconciled register and archive the others as history.
suggestions.path_b: B. Keep all seven and link them.
suggestions.recommended: A after review; no path is implemented by this section.
suggestions.why: It is the precondition for choosing any other path once.
suggestions.source_note: Repository record: the shared board and its seven source registers.

suggestions.title: Add a two-sided what-would-change-our-mind field to every strategy
suggestions.problem: A strategy entry without a falsifier cannot be retired cleanly.
suggestions.path_a: A. Add both fields at registration and freeze the text.
suggestions.path_b: B. Add a single generic field.
suggestions.recommended: A. B is not falsifiable at the required specificity.
suggestions.why: It gives the demotion gate a readable trigger.

suggestions.title: Split public analysis from private raw rows
suggestions.problem: Raw row-level files are committed to the public repository while the brief asks for a private store.
suggestions.path_a: A. Move raw rows to a private store and publish derived analysis.
suggestions.recommended: A after a terms decision; B until then is a published fact, not a violation silently ignored.
suggestions.why: It aligns publication with the source rights question.
suggestions.source_note: Repository record: quoted official reuse notice.

suggestions.title: Freeze train / validation / holdout seasons before fitting
suggestions.problem: A walk-forward warm-up inside one season is not a season-level holdout.
suggestions.path_a: A. Freeze the split in a hashed registration before fitting.
suggestions.path_b: B. Choose the split after seeing scores.
suggestions.recommended: A. B is result-chasing and is forbidden.
suggestions.source_note: Repository record: frozen rule and hash.

suggestions.title: Report ablations with uncertainty instead of fixed penalties
suggestions.problem: A fixed points-off penalty for a missing starter is an assumption, not an estimate.
suggestions.path_a: A. Fit with and without personnel features on chronological holdouts.
suggestions.recommended: A; report the difference with a confidence interval.
suggestions.why: It replaces an asserted effect with a measured one.
suggestions.source_note: Official report supplies designations, not point values.

suggestions.title: Add a drift alarm to each parser
suggestions.problem: A missing field can publish a blank table silently.
suggestions.path_a: A. Pin expected row counts and required fields, fail loudly.
suggestions.recommended: A. B and C have already allowed blanks to ship.
suggestions.why: It stops schema drift at the source rather than at review.
suggestions.source_note: Official Week 10 schedule; field set used by the venue verifier.

suggestions.title: Keep one reviewable decision surface rather than parallel boards
suggestions.problem: The same owner decision is described in several places with different IDs.
suggestions.path_a: A. Use this section as the review surface and link back to source boards.
suggestions.path_b: B. Merge all text into one page.
suggestions.recommended: A. B would destroy traceability to the earlier work.
suggestions.why: It lets a reviewer choose a path once and see what it unlocks.
